cover.title: My Story
cover.subtitle: Everything, that happened, happened not to you, but for you.

content: I couldn't even imagine that one period, even though it was the shortest of all I had, would change my life for the better.
[photo_1]
Well, I am not good at storytelling, so I will just say everything as it was. Before lyceum, I was a boy whose lifestyle was simple: nothing interesting, no chasing dreams, no hard work, and so on.
But when I started studying in group E3-22 (Third Economic Group of 2022), I changed completely.

There I met lots of people who somehow changed my life.  I met people who were always happy, who knew everything, who were just funny, who kept pushing until it was over, who were always right, and so on :) And most importantly had some philosophical moment of my life.
In this section, I just want to say a little bit about the people who somehow changed me.
Well, I think that telling you about all 25 group members would be too long and kind of off-topic, so I will talk about some people, both boys and girls.

Boys: Funny members, always making others happy, cheering everyone up, and just having a good time. I don't even know how to describe them; well, they were the main emotions and the engine of our group.

Girls: While the boys were the emotions and the engine of our group, the girls were the ones who created a rollercoaster for those emotions and were the fuel for that engine. It might sound like the boys were more important than the girls, but I can say that is not true. It is just because I am also a boy and spent more time with the boys than the girls...
And specific people: Well, there are only two people that I want to point out: one boy and one girl.

Mukhammad Amin: Well, he is just funny, and he is the reason why I started watching F1... Okay, seriously, he is a person who is just there when you need him. And that's why I pointed him out. He was just there when I was alone (: Reminding me, that kindness still exists

One girl (I can't say her name, as I haven't asked for permission :) ): Sooo, about her, the only thing that I can say is that I was scared of her. Listen, I am not scared of darkness, risk, stupid actions, or loneliness, but I was scared of her in one specific way. Her aura was too powerful. The way she defended her ideology made me scared of her... Okay, now, if you are thinking that I am kidding, I am not. She had her aura, I had my aura, and I was scared of losing to her aura's power (just think of it as the battle between Madara and Hashirama). It was a matter of honor. The way she talked, the way she acted—I couldn't lose any aura points, so I was scared, scared of losing to her.
But she was a good rival. Still, I don't know anyone who has as powerful an aura as she did. Maybe she was the reason why I defend my ideology regardless of my losses.
[quote_1]
There started my transformation journey: boys with whom I did stupid things and speedran Math, and girls (mostly one of them) who showed me how to defend my ideas.

quotes.quote_1: Don't laugh, it is true, that girl's aura still is too powerfull.

content: Ok, so that was day when I first started to interest in something not technically. Psychollogy
[photo_1]

Well, still I think that this science is hardly depenceive on time, rather than physics, math and IT, that depend on system and sizes rather than present, past and future. I mean that, today it is common to have one style of psychological profile because we use phones and technology, when in the past, people had other psychological profile because let's say they hunt animals to survive. while phycis... Anyway :)
Psychology is still cool, and if I had enough time, I would study it...
Back to that day, that day I first find out about thing called temperaments.

There are four main temperaments: Sanguine, Phlegmatic, Choleric, Melancholic. And I will write what I understand that day. I will not write what they are, because I am not sure whether I understand correctly, and for learning purpose I insist you to ckeck out more educational sources :)
[photo_2]
Sanguine: the one guy that is talkative, well-going, optimistic... Like the one who is always in good mood and acts in a very supportive way

Choleric: this one is like Sanguine, but has one different aspect. He is kinda more responsive in emotional way. I am not saying that he is more emotional, everyone is emotional, and measuring it is calculation operation, not observation...   Back to Choleric, I said that he is more responsive to events, I mean that they tend to show that they are against or for your ideas, actions because of their emotions, (not because their analyse lead them to this. IT IS JUST MY UNDERSTANDING, I KNOW I MIGHT BE WRONG, BUT COME ON IT IS PSYCHOLOGY
[photo_3]

Phlegmatic: Chil guy. Well, he is one of those who always calm and stable, who able to stay normal even under crazy conditions, because he does not want to show hes emotions (not because, this is strange, but because: why? problem will not solve itself if you show your emotions...

Melancholic: Last one :) Well, (if you, i hope, not against, i will use she instead of he, to describe this type, because in my life most girls were melancholic (i know that this is strage reason)), so she is the only type that spends queite lots of her time thinking about something interesting more related to phylosofy and emotions rather than numbers, statistics and so on. She is quite interesting to talk, because if she opens up to talk with you, and really talks to you, you will feel that you need just to listen, because there is nothing to argue, maximum you can ask...
By the way, they like reading books ¯⁠⁠¯⁠¯\_(⁠ツ⁠)_/⁠¯⁠¯⁠¯
[photo_4]

And, I don't know which is my temperaments, reason that i cross with all of them... Althoug there are much more inner temperaments, like hybrid of melancholic and choleric ...  Maybe there is one describing me...
